Sets the pixel format in FFmpeg. See [the FFmpeg docs for an explanation](https://trac.ffmpeg.org/wiki/Chroma%20Subsampling). Acceptable values: "yuv420p", "yuva420p", "yuv422p", "yuv444p", "yuv420p10le", "yuv422p10le", "yuv444p10le", "yuva444p10le".

## CLI flag

Use `--pixel-format` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--pixel-format <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--pixel-format <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--pixel-format <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--pixel-format <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--pixel-format <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#pixelformat)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#pixelformat)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#pixelformat)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#pixelformat)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setPixelFormat('yuv420p');
```
